tools.name: pestscan_test_connection
tools.description: Log in and check that the PestScan API answers. Good first call. PestScan API: GET /v1/test/connection.

tools.name: pestscan_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (companies and private persons) with their names and external ids. Use it to find a customer id. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/customers.

tools.name: pestscan_list_locations
tools.description: List customer locations (the sites that pests are checked at), with their customer id. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/locations.

tools.name: pestscan_get_location
tools.description: Get one location with its full details by PestScan id. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/locations/GetById?id.

tools.name: pestscan_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (visits) created in a date range, with status, visit type and planned dates. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/orders.

tools.name: pestscan_list_new_orders
tools.description: List order sheets that are new for this integration, not yet taken over. Reading does not confirm them. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/orders/new.

tools.name: pestscan_list_completed_orders
tools.description: List order sheets that are completed and ready for the integration. Reading does not confirm them. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/orders/completed.

tools.name: pestscan_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments with their employees, in a date range (end on or after fromDate, start on or before toDate). PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/appointments.

tools.name: pestscan_list_infestations
tools.description: List infestations (pest findings) recorded at a location, filtered by survey, bait station, pest type or date. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/infestations.

tools.name: pestscan_list_bait_stations
tools.description: List bait stations (monitoring points) with their location, optionally from a date. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/baitstations.

tools.name: pestscan_list_recommendations
tools.description: List recommendations (advice from the inspector) for locations, filtered by survey and status. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/recommendations.

tools.name: pestscan_list_consumption
tools.description: List materials used (consumption) per location or visit, in a date range. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/consumption.

tools.name: pestscan_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (technicians and office users) with their names and external ids. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/employees.

tools.name: pestscan_list_articles
tools.description: List articles (products and materials) with their category. Category 0 = rodents, 1 = insects, 2 = electric traps. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/articles.

tools.name: pestscan_list_visit_types
tools.description: List the visit types (kinds of visit) that the account uses. PestScan API: GET /v1/crm/visit-types.
